This is a humid morning. This is Friday, the eleventh of July 1980. This is the first tape that we're going to be doing in the Oral History Project with Maxine Sullivan. I thought with the first session what we do is play both of your recording sessions, and play them session by session, and get your comments on them -- see if that will trigger off some of your recollections and so on. And then, at the second session, we'll come back and go through the details.
